note: Measured numbers behind assets/results.png. Every row is reproducible from the tools in this repository; see METHOD.md for how each was obtained and BENCHMARK.md for the DAVIS protocol.

reference.note: LocoTrack-B is the base this is fine-tuned from. Included because a fine-tune that quietly lost ground on the general benchmark would be worth knowing about; it did not.

occlusion.note: Synthetic occlusion benches with exact ground truth, 8 occluders each, built with tools/make_occlusion_bench.py --occluders 8 --seed N. Held out: the shipping checkpoint was selected on an earlier bench, before these three existed.
occlusion.metric: percentage of ground-truth-occluded frames placed within 5 px

confidence.note: The model's own per-frame confidence used as a detector for its own >5 px frames.

localisation.note: Synthetic bench, exact homography ground truth, 600 tracks, raw neural output with no refinement stage.
